admission.justification: Each member protects one way the single-coordinator handover can fail: the role texts alone could disagree with the router and the operation, the manifest could still describe the old default, the host handover could tell a parented Manager to relay, the developer's answer-first duty is what keeps the developer in charge, and the closeout exception is the one execution step the retained Architect keeps; only together do they make one coherent default.

guarantee: Across the role texts, the planning and coordination operations, the router, the host handover values and the composition manifest, a delegating Architect hands coordination to exactly one agent -- one Manager for a single master, one Orchestrator above two or more concurrently worked masters (one Manager per master) -- that agent decides everything not needing the developer and reaches the Architect only for the four developer-needed categories and one final report, the developer's direct-coordination and single-master-Orchestrator choices remain available, and the Architect keeps the developer conversation, answers first and runs no execution except the developer-chosen direct-coordination paired closeout.
title: One coordinating agent under the architect
